act_name: Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973
heading: Short title and commencement
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

act_name: Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973
heading: Extension of Jurisdiction of Supreme Court
title: Extension of Jurisdiction of Supreme Court
text: 2. Extension of Jurisdiction of Supreme Court.—The Supreme Court of Pakistan shall have, in relation to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat and Malakand Protected Area, the same Jurisdiction as it has in relation to the other areas of the NorthWest Frontier Province.
raw_text:
2. Extension of Jurisdiction of Supreme Court.—The Supreme Court of Pakistan shall 
have, in relation to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat and 
Malakand Protected Area, the same Jurisdiction as it has in relation to the other areas of the North-
West Frontier Province.

text: 3. Extension of Jurisdiction of High Court.—The Peshawar High Court shall have, in relation to the Tribal Areas specified in section 2, the same Jurisdiction as it has in relation to the other areas of the North-West Frontier Province.
